choices: A simplified alternative to GridLayout for beginners
The most flexible layout manager — lets each component span multiple rows/columns with custom weights
A layout that automatically adjusts the grid to fit the screen
A layout that always uses a 10x10 grid
explanation: GridBagLayout is the most powerful (and complex) layout manager. Each component gets a GridBagConstraints object specifying: grid position, span (gridwidth/gridheight), fill, weights, insets. It's verbose but handles complex forms and dialogs.
